svg.title: 6 The 28 columns whose drawn section differs from the schedule
svg.text: 6 The 28 columns whose drawn section differs from the schedule
cm, all at one scale; long side drawn horizontal for comparison (plan orientation in 09). Locations: dashed rings on the F02 maps.
15 row: equals this type's schedule row for another storey
4 tag: equals another type's schedule on this storey
7 1 side: one dimension agrees, the other does not
2 none: no schedule row of any storey or type matches
